generator.params.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: stem subterranean and tuberous, 20 to 25 cm long, 6 to 8 cm across; leaves usually three to five. Drawn as a trunk 0.035 m in radius, staying underground; 1.4 fronds a year, as the crown's count over the three years a frond lives (estimated); first cones at 5 years (estimated, as the research note's timing table records). Female cone on a peduncle 5 to 10 cm, male cones usually one to four on peduncles 4 to 8 cm. The leaves' sizes, leaflets and posture come from its traits.

appearance.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: its leaflets' apex blunt, so they narrow only over their last sixth; their width from its traits and the rest of their look from its genus.

allometry.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: stem subterranean and tuberous, 20 to 25 cm long, 6 to 8 cm across; leaves usually three to five, 46 to 91 cm long, the petiole 22 to 30 cm; leaflets in 10 to 25 pairs, 8.5 to 12 cm by 8 to 10 mm. The whole plant's height at 30 years estimated from these, its stem (or none, where it stays underground) under a crown of young leaves standing about 0.85 of a leaf above it: about 0.55 m. Whitelock gives no ages, so the tolerance is wide.

taxon.note: Scientific and common names as the spec's authors wrote them (the scientific name where no common name is in wide use), and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit: a cycad's crown of pinnate leaves on a pachycaul stem, drawn on the palm program.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact: four seeds, so male and female plants both show.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: leaves usually three to five, 46 to 91 cm long with the petiole of 22 to 30 cm, 12 to 15 cm wide, slightly to moderately keeled: the blade, without its petiole, 16 to 69 cm (the shortest leaf less the longest petiole to the longest less the shortest).

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: petiole round, 22 to 30 cm long, 5 to 6 mm across, unarmed.

traits.leaflets.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: leaflets in 10 to 25 pairs, the lower ones overlapping.

traits.leaflet_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: median leaflets straight, 8.5 to 12 cm long; basal and apical leaflets slightly shorter.

traits.leaflet_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: median leaflets 8 to 10 mm wide, apex blunt, margin strongly revolute, entire but for a few minute teeth at the apex.

traits.leaf_posture.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: leaves erect to spreading; read as erect and spreading equally often, so drawn between.

traits.leaf_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: leaves glossy, medium to dark green; the colour by eye.

traits.cone_face_height_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: the megasporophyll's face hexagonal, 1.5 to 2 cm high by 2.5 to 3 cm wide, its terminal facet more or less flat.

traits.pollen_cone_face_height_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: the microsporophyll's face hexagonal, 3 to 5 mm high by 5 to 8 mm wide, the facets slightly obscure.

traits.cone_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: female cones solitary, cylindrical, 12 to 15 cm long.

traits.cone_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: female cone 5 to 6 cm across.

traits.cone_face_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: the megasporophyll's face hexagonal, 1.5 to 2 by 2.5 to 3 cm, its terminal facet flat.

traits.cone_shape.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: female cone cylindrical.

traits.cone_apex.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: female cone's apex blunt.

traits.cone_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: female cone dark brownish red felted; the colour by eye.

traits.pollen_cone_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: male cones cylindrical to conical, 6 to 10 cm long.

traits.pollen_cone_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: male cone 2.5 to 3 cm across.

traits.pollen_cone_face_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: microsporophylls wedge-shaped, the face hexagonal, 0.3 to 0.5 by 0.5 to 0.8 cm.

traits.pollen_cone_shape.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: male cones cylindrical to conical.

traits.pollen_cone_apex.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: male cone's apex with a short blunt apiculum.

traits.pollen_cone_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: male cone densely reddish brown felted; the colour by eye.

traits.seed_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: sclerotesta ovoid to globose, 17 to 21 mm long.

traits.seed_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: sclerotesta 10 to 14 mm across.

traits.seed_colour_ripe.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: sarcotesta orange to red when ripe; the colour by eye.

traits.sexual_system.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 308), Zamia integrifolia: male and female cones on separate plants, as in every cycad (p. 19).
